objects.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.object_id,o.type_desc,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(QUOTENAME(s.name)+'.'+QUOTENAME(o.name),'OBJECT','SELECT') AS can_select,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(QUOTENAME(s.name)+'.'+QUOTENAME(o.name),'OBJECT','VIEW DEFINITION') AS can_view_definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND o.name IN ({object_names}) ORDER BY s.name,o.name;

columns.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND o.name IN ({object_names}) ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id;

indexes.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,i.is_disabled,i.is_hypothetical,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND i.index_id>0 AND o.name IN ({object_names}) ORDER BY s.name,o.name,i.index_id,ic.index_column_id;

foreign_keys.sql: SELECT ps.name AS schema_name,po.name AS object_name,f.name AS foreign_key_name,fc.constraint_column_id,pc.name AS column_name,rs.name AS referenced_schema,ro.name AS referenced_object,rc.name AS referenced_column,f.is_disabled,f.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys f JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fc ON f.object_id=fc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.objects po ON po.object_id=f.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=po.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=po.object_id AND pc.column_id=fc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.objects ro ON ro.object_id=f.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=ro.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=ro.object_id AND rc.column_id=fc.referenced_column_id WHERE po.name IN ({object_names}) ORDER BY ps.name,po.name,f.name,fc.constraint_column_id;

view_definitions.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,OBJECT_DEFINITION(o.object_id) AS definition FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type='V' AND o.name IN ({object_names}) ORDER BY s.name,o.name;
